description_en: While the construction of this Śiva temple appears to have taken place during the Rāṇā period, the exact origin remains uncertain due to the absence of historical records.Referred to simply as aśivālaya(lit. the abode of Śiva) in this documentation due to the uncertainty surrounding its name, the temple is situated on a narrow plinth level on the eastern bank of the Bagmati river, opposite the cremation grounds. The octagonal Śiva temple, featuring a domed roof crowned with a metallic finial, has its sanctum accessible through a southern entrance adorned with a stone archway (toraṇa) showcasing a central carving of Chepu, a mythical water creature.Within the sanctum, a central stoneśivaliṅgaserves as the main deity, accompanied by two other enshrined deities—one being Viṣṇu, while the identity of the other statue remains unclear. Additionally, anotherśivaliṅga, likely transported from another location, is established to the east of the temple.The absence of inscriptions at the site contributes to the mystery surrounding the donor's identity and the year of the temple's construction. Nonetheless, the architectural characteristics of the temple suggest a construction date during the Rāṇā period (1846-1951 CE).As of October 2023, none of the daily and periodic rituals are observed at the temple, although a Rājopādhyāya Brahmin has been appointed to officiate at the temple (Vīramadhuprakāśevara Temple priest, Ghimire, male, age 55).
description_ne: ऐतिहासिक पक्षबारे जानकारी नपाइएको यस शिवालयमा राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणलाई पुजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको भएपनि नित्यपूजा बन्द भइसकेको छ ।पशुपति क्षेत्रमा आर्यघाटको पूर्वतिर बागमती नदीपारि यो शिवालय रहेको छ । गुम्बज शैलीको अष्टकोणाकारको यो शिवालय ढुङ्गा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको छ । शिवालयमा धातुको गजूर राखिएको छ । शिवालयको दक्षिणमा ढुङ्गाको द्वार बनाइएको छ । द्वारमाथि छेपु अङ्कित ढुङ्गाको तोरण राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र भित्तामा पहिचान गर्न नसकिएको एउटा मूर्ति र विष्णुको एउटा गरी दुईवटा साना मूर्तिहरू स्थापना गरिएका छन् । शिवालयको पूर्वपट्टि भुइँमा जलहरि खण्डित भएको एउटा शिवलिङ्ग रहेको छ । उक्त शिवलिङ्ग स्थायी रूपले त्यहाँ स्थापना गरिएको थिएन, अन्यत्रबाट त्यस ठाउँमा राखिएको थियो ।यो शिवालयको निर्माणसम्बन्धी कुनै ऐतिहासिक अभिलेख पाइएको छैन । निर्माण शैलीको आधारमा यो शिवालय राणाकालीन देखिन्छ ।यस शिवालयमा राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणलाई पुजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको भएपनि नित्यपूजा लगायत अन्य सबै पूजाहरू बन्द भइसकेका छन् (Priest of the Vīramadhuprakāśevara from a Ghimire caste, male, age 55) ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
